fixture: Juniper Kitchen & Bar local published customer fixture; five menus, six sections, seven Dinner items, and thirteen Drinks items

observations.afterSectionActivation: After dinner remained aria-current=location and its button stayed within the visible rail after smooth scrolling
observations.search: carrot returned one section (From the garden) and moved the current-section cue to that section
observations.menuSwitch: Switching from Dinner to Drinks navigated to the Drinks URL and cleared the search value

observations.longName: Roast chicken with charred spring leeks wrapped to two lines with its price remaining in the separate right-aligned price column
observations.drinkMenu: House lager exposes Half pint and Pint labels with their associated prices
observations.priceColumns: At 320px, repeated drink option columns began at x=20 and x=162.5 with labels and prices aligned in each column

observations.menuContent: Drink names, descriptions, and option prices reflow inside the 280px content column
observations.intentionalRailOverflowNote: Only the horizontally scrollable section rail overflows; the document itself does not

limitations: This evidence covers the local Chromium-like Codex in-app browser only.
Physical-device keyboard/safe-area behavior, separate Safari/Firefox checks, enlarged text, and independent human/customer review remain open.
Ordering/contact actions were not available on this fixture and remain unverified for UX-25.6.
